title: Sign cube and subset correspondence
statement: For a finite index set $\iota$, the map from sign assignments $x:\iota\to\{+1,-1\}$ to subsets of $\iota$ sends each assignment to the indices where its sign corresponds to the nonzero element of $\mathbb{F}_2$. This map is an equivalence, with inverse given by the corresponding sign assignment of each subset.
